args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Modify the ExportButton component to remember and restore the user's last selected export format across page reloads in the browser, using local storage or equivalent, so the format menu does not revert to CSV every time.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ExportButton component is responsible for handling export formats. This feature request is to remember the user's last selected export format across browser sessions, likely by using local storage to save and retrieve the selected format instead of always defaulting to CSV. This will prevent accidental wrong format exports and improve user experience.
